mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2200 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 100,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns after INDPRO declines are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate exceeds 3.5% annually and housing starts (HOUST) are above 2000 units, it signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3.0% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is a persistent predictor of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with lower UNRATE corresponding to positive returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the relationship between UNRATE and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3.0% annually and industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 1.5% in a quarter, it signals supply chain pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0% and INDPRO growth > 1.5% in a quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
